steps.title: Configure App Meta and Specifications
steps.description: Establish the global namespace, package name: com.real3dcaradventure.app, and custom game name 'Real3DCarAdventure'.

steps.title: Establish Android Manifest
steps.description: Create AndroidManifest.xml specifying a landscape-oriented hardware-accelerated Game Activity with required GL configurations.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Scripts
steps.description: Set up build.gradle with proper compile and target SDKs (34), tool versions, and strict Java 8 compilation compatibility.

steps.title: Create User Interface Layout
steps.description: Develop dynamic full-screen activity_main.xml layout overlaying a custom GLSurfaceView with a responsive game HUD, custom meters, and high-contrast control buttons.

steps.title: Initialize Dynamic Audio Engine
steps.description: Implement a real-time programmatic audio synthesizer using AudioTrack in MainActivity to play dynamic, variable-frequency engine sound based on throttle and current speed.

steps.title: Implement GLES 2.0 Shader Engine
steps.description: Develop safe vertex and fragment shader program loaders inside MainActivity for authentic flat-shaded and directional-lit 3D polygons.

steps.title: Define 3D Geometry and Normals
steps.description: Construct high-precision vertex, index, and normal buffers for generating 3D models (chassis, cabin, wheels, road, scenery).

steps.title: Build Game Play Mechanics & Spawner
steps.description: Write physics-based loop handling speeds up to 180MPH, drifting, deceleration, multi-lane obstacles spawner, and dynamic camera chase systems.

steps.title: Program Collision Detection and Screen Shake
steps.description: Code bounding-box based collision engine checking lane offsets, executing dramatic crash animations (shaking the 3D viewport) and synthesizing dynamic white-noise impact sounds.

steps.title: Connect Interactive Overlays and Highscores
steps.description: Hook up MainActivity click listeners, dynamic game over overlay, score counters, gear indicator, and speed dials using thread-safe state synchronization.

steps.title: Building Real3DCarAdventure
steps.description: Run the complete build, compile GLES modules, construct the project, and package the debug APK with zero errors.
